sentences.en: There can be only one queen in the hive.
sentences.zh: 蜂箱里只能有一只女王蜂。

sentences.en: They worked as diligently as a hive of bees.
sentences.zh: 他们像一群忙碌的蜜蜂一样勤奋工作。

sentences.en: Clusters of bees flitted to and from the hive.
sentences.zh: 成群的蜜蜂在蜂箱内外飞来飞去。
